question: What was the theme for the International Day for Older persons 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Digital Equity for all Ages.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****International Day for Older persons**

__
 
• Observed on **October 1 every year to **raise awareness about issues affecting the elderly, such as senescence and elder abuse.
 
• On **December 14, 1990, the United Nations General Assembly** voted to establish this day.
 
• The** holiday** was observed for the first time on **October 1, 1991**.
 
• The 2021 theme** Digital Equity for All Ages **affirms the** need for access and meaningful participation in the digital world by older persons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The theme of 2022: **The Resilience and Contributions of Older Women.**
 
• This theme will serve as a **hallmark and reminder of the significant role older women play in traversing global challenges and contributing to their solutions with resilience and fortitude.**
